label: Brand gallery
title: One colour and a touch screen
lede: Redbox had no storefront, no uniform and almost no advertising. The brand was the machine: a red cabinet about the size of a soda machine, outside a shop door. These are photographs of the kiosks from 2011 to the shutdown, with our drawings in the same spirit.
